section: You went to the playground to look

conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: When you went to the amusement park to look for Xiyuan, did you see a boy who looked like this?
Respondent: Do you know the stationery store next to the amusement park?
Respondent: A few days ago... after that boy came out of the amusement park, he went to that stationery store.
Respondent: At that time, the boy was playing with Xiyuan, so when he ran out, I watched him for a while.
Respondent: Why are you suddenly asking about this? Is he related to Xiyuan’s disappearance?
